cues.zh: 讀大學，只是為了一張文憑嗎？
cues.en: Is college just about getting a diploma?

cues.zh: 畢業之後領低薪，當個月光族？
cues.en: And then low pay, and broke by the end of every month?

cues.zh: 先別急著下結論，看看這個數字。
cues.en: Before you decide, look at this number.

cues.zh: 104人力銀行《2025科技業人才報告書》指出：軟體與工程類職務，每一個職缺，平均只有0.36位求職者。
cues.en: 104 Job Bank's 2025 Tech Talent Report found that each software and engineering opening draws only 0.36 applicants on average.

cues.zh: 換句話說，三個職缺，搶一個人才。
cues.en: In other words, three jobs are fighting over one person.

cues.zh: 人才從哪裡來？答案在新北市新店：景文科技大學，資訊與通訊系。
cues.en: So where does the talent come from? Xindian, New Taipei: JinWen University of Science and Technology, Department of Information and Communication Engineering.

cues.zh: 一條翻轉人生、通往高薪產業的捷徑。
cues.en: A shortcut that turns your life toward high-paying industries.

cues.zh: 以為只有工科生才能讀？鄭同學，高中念的是餐飲科。
cues.en: Think you need an engineering background? Mr. Cheng studied culinary arts in high school.

cues.zh: 林同學，高中念的是日文科。
cues.en: Mr. Lin studied Japanese.

cues.zh: 他們在景文考取經濟部iPAS天線設計工程師證照，一路讀到碩士。
cues.en: At JinWen, both earned the iPAS Antenna Design Engineer certificate and went on to a master's degree.

cues.zh: 如今在碩倍德、銳鋒科技任職；另一位資處科出身的學長，更進了廣達電腦。
cues.en: Today they work at tech firms, and an alumnus from a business data track joined Quanta Computer.

cues.zh: 年薪，約八十萬到一百二十萬。
cues.en: Their pay: about 800,000 to 1.2 million NT dollars a year.

cues.zh: 這裡有號稱「伍仟萬實驗室」的射頻量測中心，和5G MIMO OTA實驗室。
cues.en: Here is the so-called fifty-million lab: an RF measurement center and a 5G MIMO OTA chamber.

cues.zh: 吸波材暗室、電磁相容檢測、六軸機械手臂，科大裡的台大級設備。
cues.en: Anechoic chambers, EMC testing, six-axis robot arms. Top-tier gear inside a tech university.

cues.zh: 107年經濟部天線設計工程師初級鑑定，全國通過16人，本系就佔12位，前三名全是本系學生。
cues.en: In the 2018 national antenna engineer exam, 16 people passed nationwide. 12 came from this department, including the top three.

cues.zh: 想讀碩士？走「四加一」捷徑。
cues.en: Want a master's degree? Take the 4 plus 1 shortcut.

cues.zh: 大一到大三修完學分、申請預研生；大四實習，同時修碩一課程；
cues.en: Finish your credits in years one to three. In year four, intern while taking graduate courses.

cues.zh: 再一年，拿到碩士。
cues.en: One more year, and the master's is yours.

cues.zh: 累積財富、取得學位、職場卡位，省下整整一年。
cues.en: Earn money, earn the degree, lock in your career, and save a whole year.

cues.zh: 交通呢？安坑輕軌2023年通車，「景文科大站」就在校門口。
cues.en: Getting here? The Ankeng Light Rail opened in 2023, with JinWen University Station right at the gate.

cues.zh: 學費呢？景文每學期49,628元，比私立科大最高收費少6,056元。
cues.en: Tuition? 49,628 NT dollars per semester, up to 6,056 less than the most expensive private tech university.

cues.zh: 四年下來，最多少繳48,448元；符合教育部減免，甚至比國立還便宜。
cues.en: Over four years, you save up to 48,448. With Ministry of Education aid, it can cost less than a public university.

cues.zh: AI通、5G通、物聯網通。做中學，學中做。
cues.en: AI, 5G, and IoT. Learn by doing, and do while you learn.

cues.zh: 景文資通，萬事亨通。你的翻轉，從這裡開始。
cues.en: JinWen Information and Communication: where everything connects. Your turnaround starts here.
